_comment: What the stub answers the extract step. One rule per note, matched on the
prompt's own words and the note's heading, so that a judge's prompt, which
holds the note in full but not these words, never matches one.
Written as a model shown the masked view would answer: the client is the
placeholder the note was masked with, numbered as that note numbers it.
PLAY-6001 names Hans Muster first, so Erika Mustermann is [PERSON_2] there,
and [PERSON_1] in the other three. Every span is in the masked text, so
every answer grounds (R6.4). Only PLAY-6001's root cause names the client,
so the index's record chunk has a placeholder to carry (R21.15 row 2).

fields.value: The nightly settlement export was scheduled at a local time that did not exist on the night the clocks changed, so it never ran, and [PERSON_2]'s settlement was held for two days.
